decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher is close to the core offer, has its own product page and fits the announced push toward automated finishing, so dropping it would write off the investment for little gain.

Although distant from the core business, the UV spot varnishing system received a publicized German premiere event and home-page prominence, a visible commitment that management would need to justify reversing, and weak early results can still be blamed on the start-up phase.
The sheet preparation module builds on the established portfolio and supports inline workflow integration, so it is cheap to keep and supports the firm's stated direction.
The B2 multifinisher was announced on the home page as a new solution and is central to the automated multifinishing strategy, making the commitment strong.
The hybrid saddle stitcher is close to the core booklet-making business and has its own page, so the investment and the strategic fit both favor keeping it.

The folding add-on has a customer installation showing results, but it is only mentioned on the website, so commitment is lower and it is the most expendable product, yet it complements an existing system cheaply.
